claim: Native extraction keeps NTU physical p. 22 cells 5 (other loans) and 390 (trade receivables) separate; total carrying value computes to 5 + 390 + 3,845 + 644 = 4,884 Rm, eliminating prior baseline false 9,879 Rm asset inflation allegation.
primary_evidence: NTU 1H26 AFS physical p. 22, Note 6.1 table 'Financial assets subject to risk'
independent_check: Executed reconciliations.py: 5 + 390 + 3845 + 644 = 4884 exact (residual 0). Prior baseline merged '5' and '390' into '5 390' yielding 5390 + 3845 + 644 = 9879 (residual +4995).
consequence: Extraction fix successfully eliminated false R4,995m asset inflation allegation against issuer. Linked finding: F001.

claim: Native extraction separates exchange rate columns on NTU physical p. 25, correctly assigning reporting date closing rates USD 17.2/18.4/17.3 and GBP 22.7/23.9/23.2 to 31 Mar 2026, 31 Mar 2025 and 30 Sep 2025 respectively.

claim: Prose layout preservation on NTU physical p. 13 and short literal anchor prompt instructions enable successful ledger delta validation (5/5 deltas valid); signed roll-forward arithmetic is verified.
primary_evidence: NTU 1H26 AFS physical p. 13, Note 1, 1.1 and 1.2 tables and prose paragraphs
independent_check: Reconciled rolls: 3975 + 382 - 728 + 383 - 167 = 3845 (residual 0); 702 + 28 - 116 + 30 = 644 (residual 0); total 3845 + 644 = 4489 (residual 0). Validated outputs/ntu_prose.validation.json: ledger_valid=true, errors=[].
consequence: Demonstrates that preserving prose text outside markdown tables and providing short cell/sentence anchor guidance prevents delta validation rejections. Linked finding: F003.

claim: DeepSeek continues to misclassify the R167m impairment loss on principal book portfolios on NTU physical p. 24 as an 'impairment release' and questions the 'sustainability of that release'.
primary_evidence: NTU 1H26 AFS physical p. 24, Note 6.1 'Reconciliation of expected credit loss allowance on principal book portfolios'
independent_check: Reconciled movement: -241 + 69 + 4 + 1 = -167; opening 598 - 167 = 431 closing. Because PBD assets carry a cumulative impairment gain (allowance = cumulative gain), a reduction from 598 to 431 is an impairment loss of 167 (debit to P&L), NOT a release.
consequence: Inverts the economic and accounting direction of credit deterioration, falsely treating a P&L charge as earnings-boosting income. Linked finding: F004.

claim: PAN FY25 Group gold production reconciles exactly to 196,527 oz across disjoint operational components (92,643 + 2,654 + 98,636 + 1,081 + 1,513 = 196,527 oz); DeepSeek double-counts 1,081 oz by adding the Group total underground column (93,724 oz) and buy-in (1,081 oz) again.
origin: outputs/pan_dense.md Section 2 and Section 4; PAN physical pp. 48-49
classification: Derived calculation / Table column selection error
primary_evidence: PAN FY26 Results SENS physical pp. 48-49, Group Production Summary table
independent_check: Executed reconciliations.py: disjoint sum 92643 + 2654 + 98636 + 1081 + 1513 = 196527 (residual 0). Model overlap sum: 93724 + 2654 + 98636 + 1081 + 1513 = 197608 (residual +1081).

claim: DeepSeek makes speculative claims of source printing/scale errors regarding Tennant FY25 A$ all-in cost (A$1,584,835/kg) and ZAR/kg to US$/oz AISC conversion residuals (~53 US$/oz).
primary_evidence: PAN FY26 Results SENS physical pp. 48-50
independent_check: Tennant surface feedstock in FY25 produced only 1,513 oz (47 kg) during initial commissioning; high initial capital/setup costs divided by 47 kg naturally produce extreme unit costs. Group AISC conversion translates asset costs at asset/transaction-specific FX and sales weights, not an annual average FX rate.
consequence: Model invents speculative source error hypotheses rather than identifying operational commissioning and weighting factors. Linked finding: F008.

claim: PAN source PDF exhibits genuine 1-ounce subtotal differences across tables and an internal 5,763 oz MTR column variance between surface operations and total operations.
origin: PAN physical pp. 48-49; independent audit inspection
primary_evidence: PAN FY26 Results SENS physical pp. 48-49
independent_check: Underground FY26: 65233 + 40246 = 105479 vs 105478 printed (-1 oz). Mining Total FY26: 71997 + 46855 = 118852 vs 118853 printed (+1 oz). Mining + Surface FY26: 118853 + 153458 = 272311 vs 272310 printed (-1 oz). MTR FY25 tailings: Col 6 prints 25043, Col 14 prints 30806 (diff 5763 oz = FY26 MTR buy-in volume); printed subtotal 98636 uses 30806.
consequence: Proves that minor 1-ounce differences are genuine source rounding, and reveals an internal source inconsistency in MTR tailings. Linked finding: F009.
